# OverWatch

> Open-source physical hardware AI interlock and OLED StandBy desk companion for autonomous coding agents (Google Antigravity, Claude Code).

## Core Capabilities
- **Fail-Closed AI Interlock**: Intercepts terminal tool executions via PreToolUse lifecycle hooks on local port 49152. Commands require explicit approval on a mobile phone desk stand. Unanswered prompts time out in 20 seconds and fail closed.
- **StandBy OLED Cyberdeck**: Four glanceable 100dvh screens (Mechanical Split-Flap Clock, AI Mission Control, Windows GSMTC Media Telemetry, Workstation Macros & Universal Clipboard Beam).
- **Zero-Distraction Philosophy**: OLED #000000 true black, zero persistent cloud logging, Web Audio synthesized mechanical audio, and dual-layer screen wake lock.

## System Architecture & Protocols
- **Local Daemon**: Node.js + TypeScript listening on `127.0.0.1:49152`.
- **Relay Pipeline**: Ephemeral Supabase Realtime broadcast channel (`overwatch:{device_id}`).
- **Native Windows Services**: WinRT GSMTC media session controller, DPI-aware C# screencap utility (`screencap.exe`), and AMSI-safe clipboard integration.
